assertions.title: Trust taxonomy stays consistent across portfolio surfaces

steps.action: Open / and inspect the ORD-LGA card trust cues
steps.expected: Home card shows evidence level, source framing, and as-of language that can be compared to other surfaces
steps.observed: Home card showed MIXED evidence, 'DQN fare policy with inferred competitor response. DOT DB1B anchors + modeled policy simulation.', and 'As-of 2026-02-21' for the ORD-LGA project.

steps.action: Open /projects and inspect the ORD-LGA card trust cues
steps.expected: Projects index card exposes the same trust taxonomy on the library surface
steps.observed: Projects index loaded successfully and the ORD-LGA card repeated the same MIXED evidence posture, method/source wording, and 'As-of 2026-02-21' freshness cue.

steps.action: Open /projects/ord-lga-price-war and inspect the top summary/trust line
steps.expected: Route summary uses semantically matching evidence/source/freshness language
steps.observed: The route hero and body text described observed anchors plus inferred competitor behavior and a modeled pricing policy, and the route text exposed 'MIXED · DOT DB1B anchors + modeled policy simulation · as-of 2026-02-21' with a limitation that competitor policy is inferred, not observed from internal airline systems.

evidence.consoleErrors: Home: none observed. Projects index: none observed during this rerun. ORD-LGA route: no console errors on initial top-of-page inspection; later downward scroll attempts triggered 'Loading chunk 988 failed' for /_next/static/chunks/app/projects/ord-lga-price-war/layout-e328cd0f6908d9bc.js and repeated 'Cannot read properties of null (reading parentNode)'.
evidence.network: curl -I http://localhost:3501 -> 200 OK. Browser captured GET /, GET /projects, and GET /projects/ord-lga-price-war with route-specific JS chunks for the projects index and ORD-LGA page.

assertions.title: Portfolio-level trust cues do not overstate route-level reproducibility

steps.action: Compare the ORD-LGA trust cue on / against the route-level trust language
steps.expected: Home card should not claim stronger reproducibility or evidence posture than the route discloses
steps.observed: Home card framed the case as MIXED evidence with modeled policy simulation and an as-of date, which remained consistent with the route's mixed/observed/inferred/modeled framing and explicit limitation language.

steps.action: Compare the ORD-LGA trust cue on /projects against the route-level trust language
steps.expected: Projects index card should remain honest about modeled or inferred elements
steps.observed: Projects index card used the same MIXED evidence posture, the same method/source wording, and the same freshness cue as the home card, without claiming direct real-time telemetry or full observed truth.

steps.expected: Route-level trust surface should substantiate or narrow the portfolio-level cue rather than reveal hidden overstatement
steps.observed: Route text disclosed trust/provenance detail, current-run metadata, and assumptions/limits language including that observed airfare anchors are blended with inferred competitor behavior and modeled policy outputs, and that the recommendation should be treated as a decision aid rather than direct historical truth. This narrowed the claim rather than contradicting it.

evidence.consoleErrors: Home: none observed. Projects index: none observed during card inspection. ORD-LGA route: later scroll deeper into the route caused 'Loading chunk 988 failed' and repeated 'Cannot read properties of null (reading parentNode)', but the visible trust/provenance wording gathered before the crash did not reveal any overstatement relative to home or index cards.
evidence.network: Browser captured GET /, GET /projects, and GET /projects/ord-lga-price-war while gathering trust-cue evidence.

frictions.description: The ORD-LGA route remained inspectable at the top, but a deeper scroll during evidence capture triggered a client-side chunk-load failure and generic application-error screen.
frictions.resolution: Used the already-visible top-summary evidence plus route body text capture gathered before the crash to complete the trust comparison.

summary: Retested 2 assigned assertions. Both passed: the ORD-LGA trust taxonomy matched across home, projects index, and route summary, and the portfolio-level cues did not overstate what the route-level trust/provenance surfaces disclosed. A remaining friction persists on deeper ORD-LGA scrolling because the route can still collapse into a generic client-side chunk-load error.
